label: NASA Human Research Program hazards of human spaceflight
provenance_rule: Fields named nasa_quotes are verbatim fragments from the cited page, trimmed with the ellipsis shown. Every other text field is our wording and is labeled as such. No numbers are stated here.

hazards.name: Space Radiation
nasa_quotes: Space radiation is invisible to the human eye. It's not only stealthy, but considered one of the most hazardous aspects of human spaceflight.
NASA follows specific procedures to continuously monitor space radiation and astronauts' radiation exposure.

app_link.text: Not measured in this prototype. Planned as the Radiation Budget Coach (roadmap).
app_link.provenance: Our wording and our mapping to app metrics. Demo parameter, not NASA text.

hazards.name: Isolation and Confinement
nasa_quotes: Behavioral responses occur among groups of people far from Earth who are isolated and confined in a small space
Sleep loss, circadian desynchronization, and work overload compound this issue and may lead to decreased performance

app_link.text: The check-in records mood and the wearable records sleep, so a change in either shows up against your own baseline.
app_link.provenance: Our wording and our mapping to app metrics. Demo parameter, not NASA text.

hazards.name: Distance from Earth
nasa_quotes: Instructions, new supplies, medical care, and more become increasingly challenging to receive from Earth
NASA is developing life support systems that can regenerate or recycle consumables.

app_link.text: This is why the app works offline and why the consult brief waits for the next ground link.
app_link.provenance: Our wording and our mapping to app metrics. Demo parameter, not NASA text.

hazards.name: Gravity Fields
nasa_quotes: Floating weightlessly within a spacecraft can lead to dizziness, bone and muscle loss, vision issues, and more.
Water and other fluids in the body shift upward to the head, which may put pressure on the eyes and cause vision problems.

app_link.text: Dizziness and vision changes can be logged as a symptom on the body map. Blood pressure and heart rate are simulated and labeled.
app_link.provenance: Our wording and our mapping to app metrics. Demo parameter, not NASA text.

hazards.name: Hostile/Closed Environments
nasa_quotes: Maintaining a safe ecosystem inside a vehicle presents unique challenges,
Microbes can change characteristics in space.

app_link.text: Cabin Link compares your headaches with the CO2 of your module. The NASA hazard page does not discuss CO2; the CO2 limit comes from a separate source, see pipeline/references.py.
app_link.provenance: Our wording and our mapping to app metrics. Demo parameter, not NASA text.
